name: Talking About Hobbies
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on talking about hobbies — practice these key phrases out loud:
What do you like to do in your spare time?
I've been playing guitar since I was a kid.
You should try it sometime — it's really relaxing.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
